# Claude & Antigravity Multi-Profile (`claude-antigravity-multiprofile`)

> Run multiple isolated Claude Desktop and Google Antigravity accounts on macOS with custom window names, badged Dock icons, and zero disk overhead.

Instant APFS copy-on-write macOS bundle cloner and Mach-O launcher that isolates accounts, MCP configs, and AltTab/Mission Control window names for Claude Desktop and Google Antigravity.

## Key Capabilities

- **True macOS Window & Bundle Identity**: Replaces `osacompile` / `open -n -a` wrapper scripts with APFS copy-on-write (`cp -cR`, 0 MB disk overhead) standalone `.app` bundles, renamed Framework Helpers, distinct `CFBundleDisplayName` / `CFBundleIdentifier`, and compiled Mach-O `execv()` launchers.
- **Auto-Badged Native `.icns` Icons**: Composites high-contrast color pill badges (`WORK`, `EXTRA`, `DEV`) onto the 1024x1024 app icon and compiles native `.icns` via `iconutil`.
- **Single-Layer (Claude) & Dual-Layer (Antigravity) Isolation**:
  - `claude-profile`: Wraps `Contents/MacOS/Claude` with `--user-data-dir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Claude-<Name>"`, isolating both account login and `claude_desktop_config.json`.
  - `agy-profile`: Wraps both `Contents/MacOS/Antigravity` (`--user-data-dir`) and `Contents/Resources/bin/language_server` (`--gemini_dir="$HOME/.gemini-profiles/<Name>"`), isolating Google OAuth tokens (`jetski-standalone-oauth-token`) and `mcp_config.json` while symlinking global `GEMINI.md`, `skills`, `agents`, and `plugins`.

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/claude-antigravity-multiprofile.git
cd claude-antigravity-multiprofile
./install.sh

claude-profile create Work --color blue
claude-profile create Extra --color purple

agy-profile create Work --color blue
agy-profile create Extra --color purple --share-auth
```
